SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH n AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
), mine AS (SELECT store_id, sum(amt) AS ns FROM n GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) AS cs, count(*) AS days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, m.ns, c.cs, round(m.ns-c.cs,2) AS diff, c.days FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY 1

calls.statement: SELECT business_date, count(*) AS stores, sum(net_sales) AS ns, min(receipts) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 AND (business_date IN (DATE '2026-06-19', DATE '2026-06-20') OR store_id=125) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
period_days AS (
  SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2 AND is_trading_day
),
trading AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN period_days d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
sales AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
       ROUND(s.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM sales s JOIN trading t ON t.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
